text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty: P0 fired - inference-queue-prod backlog > 120s, autoscaler failing to add nodes (policy: spot-warmup). Pager: pd_incident_8132

oncall-alex: acked oncall. I'm looking.

sre-maya: seeing the same from dashboards, queue depth spiking across all cells in us-west-2. autoscaler metrics show scale-up requests queued, kubeapi 429s.

oncall-alex: 429s from kubeapi? could be rate limit or too many nodepool requests. any spot eviction events?

runtime-eli: yes, cloud events show multiple spot preemptions in the inference-spot-pool starting ~1811122200. warmup window is 5m, but nodes never reached Ready before eviction, so autoscaler backlog increased.

support-jen: customers reporting timeouts on LLM endpoints (chat/generation). SLA page shows 7% 5xx increase. Ops team is fielding tickets.

oncall-alex: plan: 1) add temporary on-demand nodes to buy runway, 2) reduce minReadySeconds so warmup completes faster? 3) throttle new tasks to reduce queue. Any objections?

sre-maya: +1 for on-demand. I'll trigger a manual scale to dedicated pool.

runtime-eli: manual scale cmd:```bash
kubectl -n inference scale sts inference-nodepool-ondemand --replicas=6
# also bump nodepool max for the time being in cloud console
```

oncall-alex: running now. watching node join logs...

sre-maya: kubeapi 429s dropping after we backoff some controllers, but still intermittent. nodes coming up: 2/6 Ready at 1811122402, 5/6 Ready at 1811122488.

support-jen: getting fewer customer errors, but still some latency spikes. informing CS to tell affected customers ETA ~15-20m.

oncall-alex: can we also flip fallback routing to dedicated capacity for high-latency routes? route config id: rcfg-gen-03.

runtime-eli: doing it now:```json
{"route":"/v1/generate","fallback":"dedicated-usw2","apply":true}
```

runtime-eli: fallback applied at 1811122525. traffic shifting slowly.

sre-maya: autoscaler logs show scale requests failed due to IAM quota error when creating node templates (rate limit). filing infra ticket after incident. For immediate mitigation, we should pin the nodeTemplate version and avoid API churn.

oncall-alex: noted. For now the manual on-demand nodes + route fallback has reduced queue to acceptable levels (queue depth < 30s).

support-jen: CS updated customers, created incident channel for external comms.

oncall-alex: I'll keep monitoring for another 30m then hand back to infra. if we see new spot churn, we'll escalate to platform oncall.

incident-bot: PagerDuty: acknowledged by oncall-alex at 1811122350. PD escalation stopped.

runtime-eli: follow-up action items: [1] infra: investigate quota/IAM failures when creating node templates; [2] infra: consider longer-lived warmup or add a small pool of on-demand warmers; [3] runtime: implement smarter fallback thresholds to shift earlier; [4] docs: update runbook for spot warmup failures.

sre-maya: will open infra ticket INF-2026 and assign to infra-team.

oncall-alex: creating follow-up postmortem draft and will tag owners. closing this PD for now but leaving monitoring on. :white_check_mark:

support-jen: closing CS incident after last customer confirmations.

oncall-alex: final note: impact window ~ 1811122200 - 1811122525 (~5.4m). Root cause: spot pool churn + IAM/node-template quota causing autoscaler requests to fail; mitigated by manual on-demand scale + route fallback. Postmortem to follow.
